title: Rational Application of Fertilizer Nitrogen to Soil in Combination With Foliar Zn Spraying Improved Zn Nutritional Quality of Wheat Grains
authors: Xia H, Xue Y, Liu D, Kong W, Xue Y, Tang Y, Li J, Li D, Mei P
design: Split-split-plot, 4 replicates, 3 N rates x 4 cultivars x 3 foliar treatments
notes: All plots received 30 kg ZnSO4.7H2O/ha to soil. Foliar treatments: deionized water (control), ZnSO4 0.4%, ZnSO4 0.4% + sucrose 3%. Foliar applied 4 times at 5-day intervals after flowering.
